It was almost eleven o'clock when the reading of this second scene ended. Duarte could hardly contain his anger; it was already impossible to go to Rio Comprido. It is not out of place to conjecture that, if the major were to expire at that moment, Duarte would welcome death as a blessing from Providence. The bachelor’s feelings did not convince him of such ferocity; but the reading of a bad book is capable of producing still more astonishing phenomena. Moreover, as to the bachelor’s fleshy eyes, in full view appeared the tangle of Lopo Alves, the golden strands that adorned Cecilia’s beautiful head flashed into his spirit; he saw her with blue eyes, white and rosy complexion, a delicate and graceful gesture, dominating all the other ladies who should have been in Widow Menezes’s salon. He saw that, and mentally heard the music, the discourse, the rustle of steps, and the swish of silks; while the hoarse and tiresome voice of Lopo Alves was stringing together the scenes and dialogues, with the impassibility of a strong conviction.
